description: Deterministic synthetic scenarios for the C02 voice-action tracer: one reversible text edit and one two-step edit in a fixture application, plus the guard mutations that must stop execution before any AX write. Every app name, window title, control, label, fingerprint, and value below is synthetic; nothing here was captured from a real application, and no real user text, credential, or screenshot belongs in this file.

voiceRequest.text: Set the subject to Final report
voiceRequest.grantText: Yes, set the subject to Final report

multiStep.description: The same focused field is cleared and retyped: one reversible edit in two steps, so a cancel between them leaves the cleared-but-not-retyped state visible.

guards.description: The user clicked into another control after granting: the granted target is no longer the focused one.
The window replaced its control: the live fingerprint and label no longer match the fingerprint the grant bound.
The granted control reports itself disabled at preflight.
The 30-second authorization expired before the step was preflighted; the clock has moved past the grant.

verification.note: The app accepts the AX write but does not apply it; the read-back still returns the old value, so the action must not be reported as completed.
